audit.whatIsWrong: Row 0 reads Skill although whys[0] and the early block both say to concede the opener; rows 1 and 2 read Tahm Kench although whys[1] and whys[2] describe Maokai's clean root trades; row 5 reads Tahm Kench although whys[5] calls first item a wash.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Tahm Kench / Maokai / Maokai / Skill / Skill / Skill / Tahm Kench, which matches the prose exactly.
audit.corrected: Row 0 to Tahm Kench, rows 1 and 2 to Maokai, row 5 to Skill, as one atomic group with matched content pairs and ratings.

audit.why: Four spikes present: Maokai's 2-3 window, Tahm's Level 1 lash, the level-6 roam wash, and his 2+ item attrition edge.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two slot errors run through the whole entry. Devour is his R, not his W — the page calls it 'percent-HP W (Devour)' in mid, whys[3], whys[6] and wants.foe[1]. And Tongue Lash is treated as an on-demand stun; it only stuns on the third An Acquired Taste stack. The grey health is Thick Skin (E), a shield built out of the damage you deal him.
audit.why: Riot's Q text: 'If the champion already has 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste, they are stunned and the stacks are consumed.' Riot's W is Abyssal Dive, a dive-and-knockup engage (21s at rank 1), not an escape. Riot's E converts stored damage into a shield. Q is 7s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Slots fixed and the stack rule plus real cooldowns written into tldr, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[0].d, breakdown.cooldowns, whys[3], whys[6] and wants.foe[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: The mirror recorded three mechanics absent from this side too: Sap Magic's cooldown shortens every time an enemy spell strikes Maokai, Twisted Advance is untargetable during its flight, and Sapling Toss reaches 1100 against Tongue Lash's 900.
audit.why: All three come straight from the kit files and change how the lane is played — his poke feeds your sustain, and your zoning outranges his.
audit.corrected: The Thick Skin half is written into breakdown.cooldowns and whys[3]; the Sap Magic and range facts are recorded here for a pass with room in the length band.
